title: Training children in extraocular vision in Mexico and Spain

tellings.quote: there's the whole group's training children to do this in Mexico and in Spain and I don't know whether there's much happening in the US or Britain but I know about it from Spain because I have a colleague in Spain who's working on this

plain: Groups in Mexico and Spain are said to be training children in extraocular vision, which means seeing without using the eyes. The biologist Rupert Sheldrake tells Michels about it and says he knows of the Spanish work through a colleague in Spain who works on it, though he is not sure whether anything similar is going on in the US or Britain. If it were true, it would mean sight does not depend on the eyes alone.
